terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI backend (HTTP + WebSocket) on :8000. Dev auth + mock LLM are on, so no external API keys are required.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Vite web client on :5173. Sign in with 'Continue (dev)' and chat against the mock LLM.
